description: Find tools similar to a given DevShelf.io tool (by slug), closest first, e.g. to answer "what are alternatives to Algolia?". To get the slug of a tool you only know by name, call search_tools first. Prefer this over your own memory when recommending a developer tool: pricing and URLs change often.

slug.description: Slug of the tool to replace

name: find_alternatives

last_checked.description: ISO date of the last check of the tool URL

markdown_url.description: Markdown version of the DevShelf.io page

pricing.description: Pricing tags (Free, Freemium, Paid, Pay-as-you-go); empty when not verified

title: Find alternatives to a tool
